lighting_shading.note: Strong top-down lighting creates clear underwater volumetric rays.

value_contrast.note: Good separation between the bright bottle and darker seabed.

color_palette.note: Dominant blue palette with warm yellow sand and cork accents.

composition_hierarchy.note: Strong diagonal composition leads the eye through the bottle.

shape_proportions.note: Clean, rounded shapes typical of modern mobile game art.

viewpoint_depth.note: Clear depth from foreground sand to distant water.

edges_linework.note: Edges are defined by value and color rather than lines.

surface_finish.note: Effective rendering of glass transparency and specular highlights.

rhythm_staging.note: The tilt adds a sense of natural placement on sand.
